sources.title: DAOS transaction model
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Ceph CRUSH：不同機架仍共用上游電源
related.titleEn: Ceph CRUSH: distinct racks with a shared upstream power domain
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付可重播交易 JSON、衝突與拒絕軌跡、冪等重送測例及 40/10 單位核算；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver replayable transaction JSON, conflict and rejection traces, idempotent redelivery tests and the 40/10 calculations. Keep the model entirely local and label its application-specific balance rule. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立 replica→rack 與 replica→power_domain 兩種關係；輸出此次事件的可用副本與不可用原因。
related.differenceEn: Build separate replica-to-rack and replica-to-power-domain relations. Emit surviving replicas and explicit reasons for each unavailable copy, retaining both topology dimensions in the evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 帳本規則為餘額不可負，交易需基於當前版本提交；衝突後須重讀再判斷，不可直接重送舊計算結果；初始 100 單位；第一交易扣 60。名義第二交易也要求 60，應拒絕；變更第二要求 30，重讀後可提交；名義式 100-60 = 40 balance units；變更式 100-60-30 = 10 balance units。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

給定故障事件集合，失去副本數為其電源祖先被事件覆蓋的副本基數；不是將每個中間節點重複計次；三個副本分三 rack；名義其中兩個依賴 PDU-A，變更只有一個依賴 A；此次僅使 A 失效；名義式 1+1+0 = 2 replicas unavailable；變更式 1+0+0 = 1 replicas unavailable。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Require nonnegative balance and submission against the current version. After conflict, reread and reevaluate the business rule rather than resubmitting a value calculated from a stale snapshot. Start with 100 units and commit a first debit of 60. A second debit requests 60 nominally and must be rejected after reread; changing that request to 30 allows a valid subsequent commit. Nominal 100-60 = 40 balance units; changed 100-60-30 = 10 balance units. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

For a specified failure event, lost replicas are those whose power ancestry intersects the failed domain set. Count replicas once, not every failed intermediate component along their dependency paths. Place three replicas in three racks. Initially two depend on PDU-A; after rewiring the synthetic dependency map, only one does. The modeled event removes PDU-A alone. Nominal 1+1+0 = 2 replicas unavailable; changed 1+0+0 = 1 replicas unavailable. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OCP 冷卻液：露點餘裕與凝結風險邊界
related.titleEn: OCP coolant loops: dew-point margin and condensation boundaries

Keep the model entirely local and label its application-specific balance rule. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 記錄 location、surface_temperature、dew_point、uncertainty 與時間戳；同一位置和時刻的量測才可直接比較。
related.differenceEn: Record location, surface temperature, dew point, uncertainty and timestamps. Compare observations from compatible locations and times, retaining any assumption used to approximate an unmeasured surface.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

教學凝結餘裕為 Tsurface-Tdew；負值表示模型條件下有凝結風險，正值仍需考慮感測誤差與局部差異；暴露表面 18°C；局部露點由 16°C 升至 19°C，表面溫度固定；數值差使用 K；名義式 18-16 = 2 K margin；變更式 18-19 = -1 K margin。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Require nonnegative balance and submission against the current version. After conflict, reread and reevaluate the business rule rather than resubmitting a value calculated from a stale snapshot. Start with 100 units and commit a first debit of 60. A second debit requests 60 nominally and must be rejected after reread; changing that request to 30 allows a valid subsequent commit. Nominal 100-60 = 40 balance units; changed 100-60-30 = 10 balance units. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Condensation margin is surface temperature minus dew point. A negative value signals risk under the modeled conditions; a positive value still requires allowance for measurement error and spatial variation. Keep an exposed surface at 18°C while local dew point rises from 16°C to 19°C. Temperature differences are reported in K, and the dew points are given fixture inputs rather than calculated humidity measurements. Nominal 18-16 = 2 K margin; changed 18-19 = -1 K margin. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
